critique: The black background and isolated cellular sprite forms are directionally appropriate, and the two frames show the cells changing position rather than remaining static. However, the result still reads as a field of sharp neon bacteria, not the softer, calmer Nature preset thumbnail. There are too many equally prominent particles, the pink/orange edges are overly saturated, and the motion between 0.08 s and 2 s is still noticeably dispersed rather than gently suspended.

suggestions.why: Reduce the burst population substantially so the frame has more of the intended spacious floating-cell field.
Lower base velocity so cells drift instead of visibly dispersing from the burst.
Increase air resistance to further damp the burst momentum and create gentler suspended motion.
Reduce the harsh bright neon prominence of every sprite, allowing the field to feel softer and more natural.
